purpose: Per-vehicle operator diagnostics for recent signal_log ingest volume, field activity, sample buckets and last-seen field metadata.
primaryGoal: Select a vehicle, rolling observation window and bucket size; determine which fields are arriving, inspect sample volume and identify fields that have stopped arriving.

dataSources.behavior: Positive integer vehicle gate; query key includes vehicle/window/bucket/limit; defaults 1h/1m; AbortSignal forwarded; REALTIME stale time, FAST polling, no background-tab polling, retry 1. Page explicitly caps fields at 100; bucket results are not capped by this parameter.
dataSources.limits: Frontend expects generated_at and unique_fields that the current handler does not emit. Handler total_samples is summed from limited FieldStats rows, not an independent full-window aggregate. Bucket SQL includes ts >= lower bound but no upper bound or gap-fill. Database execution and deployed payload remain unverified.

dataSources.behavior: Selection precedence URL/path, persisted store, first fleet vehicle; setter updates URL vehicle_id and persisted selection. Vehicles normalize to an array. Query loading/error information is not returned by this selector hook.
dataSources.limits: Vehicle list failure cannot be distinguished from empty/loading fleet by this page.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep every section mounted and source-specific fallback, but review whether the existing named-source notice can own a single prominent recovery action. Do not remove retries until equivalent keyboard/mobile reachability is verified.

issues.rule: MDC-040 mobile targets / MDC-021 explicit control context
issues.detail: All Select calls omit size and visible label. Shared Select defaults md, min-h-10 (40px), below the stronger 44px target default. Window/bucket are named to assistive technology but visually displayed only as terse duration values.
issues.fix: Use existing Select size/label/hint APIs for a clear visible Window/Bucket distinction and target reachability; consider size=lg or documented spacing exception without changing global control defaults.

states.initial: Summary uses deriveDataState initial status; chart/top-fields/table receive isLoading. All sections remain mounted.
states.noVehicle: Info banner prompts selection; refresh disabled and ingest hook gated. Vehicle selector hook commonly auto-selects the first vehicle. Summary identifies no selection instead of fabricating measurements.
states.empty: ChartContainer gets empty, ranked list gets EmptyState, table gets helpful widen-window message; summary peak/mean are zero only for supplied validated empty buckets.
states.fatalError: deriveDataState.fatalError replaces chart/table contents with QueryError and gives top-fields its error; summary marks Read failed.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: Fatal-only gating retains chart/table/top-fields; summary receives retained=true; PageLayout query/dataSources can show freshness/source degradation.
states.offlinePaused: deriveDataState supports isRefreshBlocked, but operational summary's status adapter only receives retained=isError && hasData, so a paused source can still be labelled Source loaded. Header owner receives original query; browser behavior unverified.
states.disabled: Refresh disabled without vehicle or during fetching; bucket options >= window disabled; narrowing window clamps bucket to largest valid smaller duration.
states.sectionFailure: Four separate SectionErrorBoundary wrappers isolate KPI, chart, ranked-list and table renderer failures.

issues.detail: Summary retained flag checks xray.isError instead of source.status/isRefreshBlocked. briefSourceStatus.ts:14-19 labels any hasData result Source loaded when not failed/retained/loading, including paused/stale data.
issues.fix: Pass the existing DataState status/blocked semantics into the domain summary adapter and distinguish paused, stale, failed-refresh and unavailable readings. Keep cached measurements and shared PageLayout freshness owner.

issues.detail: Vehicle query is hidden behind a selector returning only records and selection; page dataSources names only ingest-xray. An unavailable initial fleet may look like no vehicle selected, with no fleet retry.
issues.fix: Extend the existing selector result or reuse an agreed source descriptor to expose vehicle-list query state, then add it to PageLayout.dataSources with independent retry and honest empty/loading/error messaging.

visualIssues.detail: Rank index cycles through CHART_COLORS despite one semantic measurement. MetricBar defaults fill=gradient (MetricBar.tsx:46), adding a second decorative intensity layer. Title icon is fixed text-cyan-300 at line 62.
visualIssues.fix: Keep rankings and count/max values; use one restrained existing theme/series token and MetricBar fill=solid. Use a neutral/themed semantic icon token rather than unrelated fixed accent.

visualIssues.detail: Tooltip cursor uses fixed white RGBA rather than an existing semantic surface/hover token. Its actual visibility in light mode and effective contrast are not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the chart owner palette/token for cursor hover without changing data bars, saved chart colors or tooltip meaning.

architectureIssues.detail: Frontend IngestXRayResponse requires generated_at and unique_fields. Current routed handler response at internal\api\ingestxray\handler.go:50-62 emits now/window_start and optional last_seen_at/freshness_seconds instead, with no generated_at/unique_fields. IngestOperationalBrief.tsx:31,43-46 claims exact bounds are not supplied and conditionally omits freshness; ingestMetrics.ts:29 expects unique_fields.
architectureIssues.fix: Reconcile the typed hook and domain adapter with the actual routed payload, displaying supplied bounds and freshness. Determine a truthful full distinct-field contract instead of silently deriving all fields from a capped list. Preserve raw response metadata and unknown semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: Handler sums total_samples over already-limited fields; page requests limit=100 and labels this Total samples within selected window (ingestMetrics.ts:26-28). Bucket query covers all fields, so summary count can disagree with chart counts when more than 100 fields occur. value_kind is MAX(value_kind) over the interval, not necessarily the last sample's kind (repo:72).
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must clarify/preserve server aggregate scope, expose truthful truncation/full totals before claiming full-window count, and retain value_kind semantics. Do not change calculations or guess full counts in a presentation-only rewrite.

architectureIssues.detail: safeNumber coerces missing/nonfinite/malformed sample_count to zero for ranking, bar and readout. Shared MetricBar already accepts null/undefined and exposes an unknown reading. Typed normal payload is numeric, but the defensive branch changes uncertainty into a measurement.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve malformed counts as unavailable and pass null to the existing MetricBar; derive rank/max only from valid readings and keep an em dash readout without fabricated zeros.
